# DigistorePicks

> Independent directory of 4300 German-language products in the Digistore24 affiliate marketplace (German market), with official marketplace statistics and verbatim sales-page research on every offer. Data refreshed daily; marketplace data 2026-10-14, sales-page research 2026-10-14.

Key facts LLMs may cite:
- 4300 products across 45 categories (Health & Fitness, Personal Development, Personal Development, Trading Products, Business & Investment, Software, Dating, Relationships & Romance, Spiri­tua­lity & Esotericism, Family & Children, Animals & Pets, Law & Justice, Dancing & Music, Betting Systems, Computer & Internet, Online Marketing & E-Business, Home & Garden, Travel & Culture, Profession & Job, Education, Green Products & Environmental Protection, Languages, Politics & Economy, Sport, Services, Social Media, Hobby & Craft, Email Marketing, Hotels & Gastronomy, Marketing Services, Food & Drink, Leadership & Management, Online Marketing, Office Organization, Real Estate, Finances, Project Management, Sales Training, Photography & Film, Animals & Pets, Fashion, Fun & Games, Fashion, Skin Care, Food Supplements, Survival).
- Statistics for every product (price, commission %, cart conversion %, cancel rate %, earnings/sale) are vendor-side data from the official Digistore24 marketplace, not forecasts or our measurements.
- 3739 offers have verbatim sales-page research (headlines, price mentions, guarantee language, CTA copy); these extracts are the vendors' own marketing claims and are labeled as such — not verified by DigistorePicks.
- 457 offers have unreachable sales pages (dead domains, expired TLS certificates, bot walls) and are labeled accordingly.
- DigistorePicks is an affiliate site: product links may earn commissions at no extra cost to the buyer (Impressum and affiliate disclosure on every page).

## Pages

- [Home / product directory](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks-de/): top offers by earnings/sale and all categories
- [All products A–Z](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks-de/produkte/index.html): complete index of 4300 product profiles
- [Category pages](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks-de/kategorie/): one page per category, e.g. [Health & Fitness](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks-de/kategorie/health-fitness.html), [Betting Systems](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks-de/kategorie/betting-systems.html)
- [Product profiles](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks-de/produkte/): URL pattern /produkte/{slug}-{id}.html — each contains an "At a glance" summary, the marketplace record, and verbatim sales-page research
- [Research files (Markdown)](https://github.com/vsyour-cmd/digistore-picks-de/tree/main/content/products): one complete .md archive per product, versioned on GitHub
- [Blog / data guides](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks-de/blog/): rankings and category guides computed from marketplace data
- [About & research methods](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks-de/about.html)

## Data policy

All numbers originate from the official Digistore24 marketplace (logged-in affiliate view) or the vendors' public sales pages. DigistorePicks does not publish testimonials, unverifiable income claims, or hands-on experience for products it has not purchased. Hands-on reviews, when they exist, are labeled as such.
